entry.title: On Broken Ground
entry.summary:
Author: Obito_x_rock

Rating: MatureLanguage: EnglishWords: 6,066Chapters: 4/?Kudos: 24

Summary: Following a devastating, unprecedented earthquake and official government abandonment, Gotham City is declared an "Uninsurable Disaster Zone" and placed under a strict military blockade. Cut off from the rest of the world, a fierce wave of Gothamite nationalism begins to rise from the rubble. Stripped of his high-tech arsenal, with the Batcave drowned in mud and the Batfamily stranded outside the borders, Bruce Wayne chooses to step forward and lead the city with an open face. This is no longer a war of shadows. It is a brutal battle of logistics, backroom diplomacy with Gotham's underworld, and raw human resilience. Because if the mainland has left them for dead, Gotham will rebuild itself alone.

entry.title: Why The Robins Came Home
entry.summary:
Author: Smarty2604

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 25,356Chapters: 3/30Kudos: 39

Summary: Dick shows up with twins and a letter that changes everything. Jason comes home with a daughter and a heartbreak he can't fix, no matter how hard he tried. Damian returns without warning, carrying two sons—more responsibility than he’s ever known, and the certainty that he has no room left for pride. And Tim—Tim's world has shattered in a way that he doesn't know if he'll come back from. But he has to. For his son. Two weeks doesn’t sound like long—until you’re raising a baby alone. One by one, the Robins come home carrying infants, exhaustion, and a grief that refuses to wait for you to be ready. The kind that doesn't care how strong you are. What they find isn’t a mission or a mantle—but a family learning how to stand still long enough to heal. Bruce Wayne expects a productive day at the Batcomputer.Instead, he gets his sons back in a single heartbreaking evening. This is where the legacy begins.This is why the Robins came home.

It would have been comical, if Jason wasn’t sitting on the kitchen counter, miserably drenched head to toe in mud and rainwater, chewing on the leftovers of a sandwich that definitely wasn't his. "And for the sake of your dignity, Todd, do not speak with food in your mouth." --- Or; the batfam, but as a 2010s sitcom because i can't help myself. i like found family and fluff for these guys, sue me
